beats.job: Follow one work item end to end
beats.viewer_question: What happens to a request after it is submitted?
beats.intended_understanding: The same item passes intake, decision, and execution in order.
beats.initial_state: The item waits at the intake gate; the path ahead is dim.
beats.transformation: The item travels the path, lighting each stage as it enters.
beats.proof_state: The item is inside the decision stage, unchanged in identity.
beats.final_state: The item exits execution marked complete.

beats.viewer_question: What decides whether the item proceeds?
beats.intended_understanding: One gate checks the item and routes it onward or back.
beats.initial_state: The gate is closed; the return path is faint.
beats.transformation: The gate inspects the item and the onward path lights.
beats.proof_state: The item is routed onward; the return path stays dark.
beats.final_state: The diagram holds with the taken path lit.

beats.proof_state: The line is the only bright element.
beats.final_state: The line holds to the cut.
essential_text: Every request passes the same gate
